# SOP-P1-L2-02 Product changeover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-041, MM-P1-L2-RR01, SOP-P1-L2-03

Purpose
1. This procedure defines required steps, safety precautions, and recordkeeping for product changeover on the Ring Rolling line at P1-L2. It covers removal and installation activities for tooling, setup verification, material handling handoffs, and process checks necessary to place the line into production for the new part.

Background and scope
2. The Ring Rolling line comprises the radial ring rolling mill, induction billet heater, and hydraulic transport modules identified as EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, and EQ-P1-L2-HT03. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. This SOP applies to mechanical, process, and electrical technicians performing changeover tasks and to area leads responsible for sign-off.

Preconditions
3. Verify that production authorization for the new part is present and approved per ECN-2026-041. Confirm that maintenance holds are cleared and that MM-P1-L2-RR01 has no active open maintenance work orders affecting changeover scope. Confirm that SOP-P1-L2-03 has been reviewed for line-specific startup sequence for post-changeover validation.

PPE
4. Minimum PPE must be worn during all activities:
   - Safety glasses with side shields.
   - Cut-resistant gloves for tooling handling.
   - Heat-resistant gloves when handling recently heated billets associated with EQ-P1-L2-IH02.
   - Steel-toe safety boots.
   - Hearing protection in designated high-noise zones.
   - High-visibility vest.

Roles and responsibilities
5. Line Lead: Authorize changeover start, assign crew, and verify paperwork.  
6. Mechanical Technician: Execute tooling removal/installation on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 and EQ-P1-L2-HT03.  
7. Electrical Technician: Isolate and re-energize electrical panels as required for tooling changes.  
8. Process Technician: Configure induction heater program and confirm lubricant provisioning for EQ-P1-L2-IH02. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is CFW-LUB-788.  
9. Quality Inspector: Measure first article and approve dimensional conformance.

Procedural steps (numbered)
10. Prepare and isolate
   10.1. Convene crew, review scope and permit requirements from ECN-2026-041.  
   10.2. Lockout/tagout affected equipment according to plant LOTO policy. Verify zero energy state before proceeding.

11. Remove current tooling and fixtures
   11.1. Document current tooling identifiers and condition in the changeover log.  
   11.2. Remove rollers, mandrels, and fixture plates from EQ-P1-L2-RR01 following manufacturer guidance recorded in MM-P1-L2-RR01. Store components on designated racks and tag with part IDs.

12. Inspect and prepare equipment
   12.1. Perform visual inspection of the machine bed and lubrication points. Record any abnormal wear or damage in the maintenance log.  
   12.2. Install replacement or adjusted tooling for the new product as per tooling build sheet. Verify fit and fastener engagement by visual and tactile confirmation.

13. Set up induction heater and transfer modules
   13.1. Confirm billet size and material specification match the incoming workorder and ECN-2026-041.  
   13.2. Provision lubricant CFW-LUB-788 to the service reservoir for EQ-P1-L2-IH02 and record lot number and quantity dispensed into the equipment maintenance log.  
   13.3. Verify hydraulic couplings and transport guides on EQ-P1-L2-HT03 are positioned for the new part geometry.

14. Functional checks (pre-power)
   14.1. Remove mechanical holds and perform manual rotation or movement checks where applicable to confirm free travel.  
   14.2. Reconfirm no tools or loose items remain in the work envelope.

15. Electrical re-energize and system checks
   15.1. Electrical technician re-energizes control panels and brings systems to ready state following plant procedures.  
   15.2. Execute dry runs and interlock verification. Document controller reported faults and clearing actions.

16. First-article production and inspection
   16.1. Produce an initial ring and route it to Quality. The Quality Inspector must document dimensional results and accept or reject per drawing and ECN-2026-041 disposition.  
   16.2. If rework or adjustment is required, document corrective actions and re-run first article.

17. Recordkeeping and handover
   17.1. Complete the changeover checklist, including tooling IDs, lubricant CFW-LUB-788 lot number, and any deviations from standard settings. File the checklist in the electronic document control system under SOP-P1-L2-02.  
   17.2. Update the line setup entry in the production log and notify planning that the line is ready for production.

Step rationale and examples
18. Tooling documentation prevents incorrect reuse of worn mandrels and ensures traceability. Example: tagging removed rollers with their unique IDs reduces risk of installing a roller with excessive eccentricity.  
19. Recording lubricant lot numbers for CFW-LUB-788 enables root cause tracing in case of surface finish anomalies or lubrication-related wear issues.  
20. Performing a first-article inspection before full-rate production reduces scrap and meets process-control expectations in ECN-2026-041.

Records to keep
21. Changeover checklist completed under SOP-P1-L2-02.  
22. Tooling disposition log and tag photographs.  
23. Lubricant provisioning record including part CFW-LUB-788 lot information.  
24. First-article inspection report and disposition referencing ECN-2026-041.  
25. Any maintenance findings entered into MM-P1-L2-RR01.

Nonconformance and escalation
26. If first-article rejects persist after two documented adjustment cycles, stop the line and escalate to Engineering per ECN-2026-041. Do not resume production until disposition is approved.

Sign-off
27. Signatures required before production handover:
   - Mechanical Technician: ______________________  
   - Electrical Technician: ______________________  
   - Process Technician: ______________________  
   - Quality Inspector: ______________________  
   - Line Lead: ______________________

Revision history
28. See document control for revision history and related change details referenced by ECN-2026-041.

End of SOP-P1-L2-02.
